description: Native Hermes Honcho tool and raw MCP endpoint usage. Estimated payload tokens describe serialized tool/MCP request and response payloads only; they are not model-provider billing tokens and not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption.

options.content:
# Honcho Tool Usage

Two independent telemetry sources are shown below: **native Hermes Honcho tools** and **raw MCP endpoint calls**.

> **Estimated payload tokens** are estimated tokens in serialized MCP/tool request and response payloads. They are **not model-provider billing tokens** and **not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption**.

## Native Hermes Honcho tools
Metrics from the Hermes plugin exporter (`hermes_honcho_tool_*`). Filter by Hermes profile and tool name.

panels.title: Native tool calls by outcome (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative calls observed since the currently running Hermes process started. This displays the first call immediately; counters reset when that Hermes process restarts. Native built-in Honcho calls only, not raw MCP HTTP traffic.

panels.title: Native mean tool duration
panels.description: Mean native tool-call duration since the currently running Hermes process started. It displays after the first call; percentile estimates require multiple calls and are not used here.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (hermes_honcho_tool_duration_seconds_sum{job="hermes_honcho_tools", profile=~"$native_profile", tool_name=~"$native_tool"}) / sum by (tool_name) (hermes_honcho_tool_duration_seconds_count{job="hermes_honcho_tools", profile=~"$native_profile", tool_name=~"$native_tool"})

panels.title: Native serialized payload volume (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative serialized tool request/response payload bytes since the currently running Hermes process started. Content, session IDs, task IDs, filesystem paths, and credentials are never exported.

panels.title: Native estimated serialized payload tokens (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative estimated serialized tool request/response payload tokens since the currently running Hermes process started, using bytes_div_4. Not model-provider billing and not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name, direction, tokenizer) (hermes_honcho_tool_payload_tokens_estimated_total{job="hermes_honcho_tools", profile=~"$native_profile", tool_name=~"$native_tool", tokenizer=~"$native_tokenizer"})

options.content:
## Raw MCP endpoint calls
Metrics from the raw MCP worker (`honcho_mcp_tool_*`). These represent endpoint traffic separately from the native Hermes plugin. Cumulative panels and mean duration show the first scraped call immediately; process counters reset when the MCP worker restarts.

panels.title: Raw MCP calls by outcome (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative raw MCP endpoint calls since the currently running MCP worker started. This displays the first scraped call immediately; counters reset when that worker restarts.

panels.title: Raw MCP mean call duration
panels.description: Mean raw MCP endpoint-call duration since the currently running MCP worker started. It displays after the first call; percentile estimates require multiple calls and are not used here.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (honcho_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_sum{job="honcho_mcp", tool_name=~"$mcp_tool"}) / sum by (tool_name) (honcho_mcp_tool_duration_seconds_count{job="honcho_mcp", tool_name=~"$mcp_tool"})

panels.title: Raw MCP serialized payload volume (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative serialized MCP request/response payload bytes since the currently running MCP worker started, grouped by endpoint tool and direction.

panels.title: Raw MCP estimated serialized payload tokens (cumulative)
panels.description: Cumulative estimated serialized MCP request/response payload tokens since the currently running MCP worker started. Not model-provider billing and not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name, direction, tokenizer) (honcho_mcp_tool_payload_tokens_estimated_total{job="honcho_mcp", tool_name=~"$mcp_tool", tokenizer=~"$mcp_tokenizer"})
